summary: st-test re-executes the base's own scripts/st-test when the branch's copy differs, so pool-tree queueing, build admission and which commit is signed are always main's, however old the branch

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: The gate's rules are unchanged; the signing driver now comes from the accepted base, as the wrapper, signer and verifier already did.

compatibility.detail: A branch's edits to scripts/st-test no longer drive its own signing run; they are tested by its ci-script-tests. A base without scripts/st-test, or with the same file, runs the branch's copy as before.

recovery.detail: Revert the change; until the revert reaches a branch, ST_TEST_REEXEC set to any value makes a run use its own copy.
